item.title: Influencer
item.description: Motivation This project was inspired by an incident in Diphu, India, in 2018, where two friends were attacked while heading to a scenic place just because they looked different. We want to explore the feelings people might have in similar situations where they feel isolated and face discrimination. The project aims to design a game that takes players through different negative emotions, starting from a sense of safety and happiness to confusion, unease, powerlessness, anxiety, and possibly even despair.

item.title: Absinthe Tails
item.description: Overview Take a sip of absinthe, and join this green-hued quest for a lost, fuzzy kitten. Absinthe Tails is a detective game with a dash of absinthe and missing cats. As Claude, a detective with a penchant for spirits, your task is to unravel the mysteries surrounding your quaint town. Armed with photographs from around the town and vibrant dreams to supplement your alcohol-clouded memory, you must piece together the clues to solve the case.

item.title: How should I look today!
item.description: Overview Enter the shoes of a social media traveler, eager to discover a land renowned for its unique apple varieties. Your mission: purchase an apple. But blending in proves difficult as locals eye you with suspicion. Can you convince them of your harmless intentions, or will it lead to dire consequences? Objective The assignment delves into the repercussions of standing out in a crowd , inspired by a real-life incident with severe consequences, prompting exploration of the emotions and reactions triggered when one is perceived as different among peers .

item.title: How should I look today! - a game poem
item.description: Overview Enter the shoes of a social media traveller, eager to discover a land renowned for its unique apple varieties. Your mission: purchase an apple. But blending in proves difficult as locals eye you with suspicion. Can you convince them of your harmless intentions, or will it lead to dire consequences? My role as Game Designer This project was inspired by Jordan Magnuson’s game poems. Dedicated to the events of the Diphu incident of 2018, the game poem delves into the complexities of human behavior towards those unfamiliar to them, encompassing aspects such as appearance, food, culture, and geography.

item.title: Thoughts Out!
item.description: Overview Thoughts Out! is a 3D platform puzzle game set in a dreamlike world where your everyday office troubles morph into an annoying dragon. This dragon can alter the surrounding environment, making your adventure either easier or more challenging. How can you drive it out of your daydream and reclaim your peace of mind? Calm down and first, listen to what Miss Bellflower has to say. Tools used Unreal Figma Pen and paper My role as Tutorial and Level Designer Collaborating with a team of eight individuals, we embraced various roles to enhance the project.

item.title: Monster Cleaning Inc
item.description: Overview Welcome to Monster Cleaning Inc., located in the heart of an RPG world! After nasty battles, these monsters need a good scrub. You need to use the right-sized sponge to clean it. Your cleaning skills will be judged by the monsters themselves, and their ratings will determine your success. Can you earn that coveted five-star review? Step up, clean them up quickly and get them ready for their next encounter! Tools used Unity Figma Pen and paper My role as Game Designer This game was crafted for Game Maker’s Toolkit 2024.
